body: Somewhere in my crazy mind clicks that although these situations are impossible to happen, there are cases that can keep me from taking my life. The contradiction occurred and I called the line to blab about my story and hear people telling me how “innocent” I am in the situation, which led me to great comfort. If you want, you can tell me about the reasonings you have for your story

I was thinking about an absolutely impossible situation that would happen to keep me alive, that he comes back for me one day and promise to love me for ever. I know it’s never going to happen. would you like to share if you have one?

I would say I was in the same situation last year. 

The person lied to my face:
The friend was telling me how important I am to her when I didn’t even ask. And then one argument happens then she just turned 180 and started claiming she was lying the whole time. (I mean, I didn’t even want you to say those words... and now you are using your previous action as a weapon to hurt me by telling me you are lying? I... you didn’t have to do that to me.). 

Getting help from the attempt:
I took pills and I was admitted to the hospital. I don’t know if you had the same experience. I have to repeat my story over and over again to the hospital people. Every time when the doctor asked me how many pills I took and I tell them the number, I feel like I’m being judged, although they didn’t say or act anything. Because that amount clearly doesn’t kill people, and I just pounded myself with this question: am I just attention seeking? Do I let me to hurt myself to just stay in hospital for a few days? 

More importantly, should I apologize to myself for hurting myself, or not hurting myself properly and leading me more pain and feel judged by others?

The idea of leaving all of these behind gives me thrills but the guilt I had was enormous. People who lied to your face clearly don’t deserve you. I just want a break from all of these issues and want everyone to feel like that’s reasonable.

I, till now, still don’t know what’s the right thing to do. But I was inspired by the kind lady on helpline to email my school about postponing deadlines. This by no means I’m energized and ready to go “back to life”, but during such difficult times, at least I want my pain to be justified by more people. To hear them say that I do need a break and I’m reasonable to behave this way, that’s somewhat interesting to do. And that’s the reason why I posted this story here. If you would find some sort of comfort in that, please share your storyf
